changes.connected_observation_preview: A wrist observation is executed only after its planned endpoint joint state can continue through the same collision-sampled lift, reorientation, safe-corridor and pregrasp segments used by execution.
changes.post_refinement_gate: The wrist-fused target pose receives a second current-state-to-pregrasp, grasp and retreat evaluation before the PickAndPlace action is sent.
changes.bounded_orientation_search: Both bounded pregrasp orientations are tested for connected current-state feasibility before rejecting a target.
changes.trajectory_limits: Every direct arm trajectory is rejected before controller submission if it exceeds 512 points, 40 rad cumulative joint travel or 60 s nominal duration.
changes.single_side_contact_recovery: A strict attachment rejection after a successful close now triggers the same one-time, collision-checked orthogonal contact retry as an asymmetric close result. Dual-contact attachment remains mandatory.
